testcase.name: say is broadcast to everyone through the chat dispatch; the message is sanitised
sethealth and teleport mutate the authoritative player, errors mutate nothing
help listing is filtered: a player sees only what they may run
an ordinary player is refused privileged commands with the typo response
kick tells the player and closes their slot, and cannot target yourself
overlong and empty lines are refused before parsing
a forged capability cannot exist: there is no packet path into the resolver
a granted caller runs cheats; an omitted state toggles the flag
the command budget is six per window per caller, not per victim
give applies a requested primary immediately through the respawn path
